description: Send a batch of transactional emails in one Mailtrap API call. Shared fields go on `base`; per-recipient overrides go in `requests[]`. Each request must include `to`.

base.description: Shared fields applied to every request in the batch. Each request can override individual fields.

from.description: Sender as `{ email, name? }` (a bare email string is also accepted). Omit if `DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL` is set.

html.description: Optional HTML body. Omit when using `template_uuid`.

reply_to.description: Optional reply-to address as `{ email, name? }` (a bare email string is also accepted).

subject.description: Email subject. Required for inline sends; omit when using `template_uuid`.

template_uuid.description: Use a Mailtrap template instead of inline content. Mutually exclusive with `subject`/`text`/`html`/`category`.

template_variables.description: Variables for the referenced template. Only allowed together with `template_uuid`.

text.description: Email body text. Required for inline sends; omit when using `template_uuid`.

requests.description: Per-recipient messages. Each request must include at least one recipient via `to`, `cc`, or `bcc`; other fields override `base`.

bcc.description: Optional BCC recipients as `{ email, name? }` objects (bare email strings also accepted)

items.description: Address with optional display name (a bare email string is also accepted)

cc.description: Optional CC recipients as `{ email, name? }` objects (bare email strings also accepted)

items.description: Address with optional display name (a bare email string is also accepted)

html.description: Optional HTML body. Omit when using `template_uuid`.

reply_to.description: Optional reply-to override for this request as `{ email, name? }` (a bare email string is also accepted).

subject.description: Email subject. Required for inline sends; omit when using `template_uuid`.

template_uuid.description: Use a Mailtrap template instead of inline content. Mutually exclusive with `subject`/`text`/`html`/`category`.

template_variables.description: Variables for the referenced template. Only allowed together with `template_uuid`.

text.description: Email body text. Required for inline sends; omit when using `template_uuid`.

to.description: Recipients as an array of `{ email, name? }` objects (bare email strings are also accepted as items). Optional if `cc` or `bcc` is provided; at least one of `to`/`cc`/`bcc` must contain a recipient.

items.description: Address with optional display name (a bare email string is also accepted)

name: batch-send-transactional-email
